observation_summary: The StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml method incorrectly handles Unicode characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP), splitting them into two surrogate pairs instead of escaping the single combined codepoint.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves changing the iteration logic from processing individual 16-bit 'char' units to using 'Character.codePointAt' to correctly identify full Unicode codepoints. It also adds a specific conditional branch to handle these high-codepoint characters (>= 0x010000) by incrementing the loop index to skip the second half of the surrogate pair. This is a procedural change to the algorithm used for string traversal and escaping, not a simple guard or initialization error.
evidence_used: The diff replaces 'char c = str.charAt(i)' with 'int c = Character.codePointAt(str, i)'.
The diff adds a conditional branch 'if (c >= 0x010000 && i < len - 1)' to handle surrogate pairs.
The diff includes 'i++' to skip the second part of the surrogate pair, which is a change to the loop iteration strategy.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix adds a conditional check, the core issue is the underlying algorithm's inability to correctly interpret and process Unicode codepoints beyond the BMP, requiring a change in how the string is traversed and consumed.
